title: Appeals Desk Note: Appealing a Denied Home Oxygen Therapy Equipment Month
content:
# Appealing a Denied Equipment Month — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** A denied Home Oxygen Therapy equipment month may be appealed through a redetermination appeal request naming it as the related line. The appeal is filed no later than the coverage class's redetermination window days after the denial is received, counting calendar days from the day after the denied line's adjudication date with the boundary day included. A denial as cap reached or for an inpatient stay is not appealed; a retest missing or mobility not documented denial is appealed only when the proof was on file before the denial.

## The appeal window as a time gate

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the denial is received |
| Record that shows it | the adjudication date of the denied line (system record) |
| Counting | calendar days, from the day after the adjudication date |
| Length | the coverage class's redetermination window, in days |
| Comparison | the appeal is filed no later than the last day of the window |
| The last day itself | included |

## Denial reasons

| Denial reason | Appealed |
|---|---|
| cap reached | no |
| inpatient stay | no |
| retest missing | only when the proof was on file before the denial |
| mobility not documented | only when the proof was on file before the denial |

## Boundary example (hypothetical)

With a hypothetical window of 120 days and an adjudication date of 1 March, day 1 of the count is 2 March and day 120 is 29 June. An appeal filed on 29 June is within the window; one filed on 30 June is not.
